content: NotebookLM is the citation-UX benchmark. Grounded answers carry inline citations; hover previews the quoted text; click opens the source scrolled to the passage. Citations map to text or images. Closed RAG over user-supplied sources only. Known weakness: no page/paragraph reference usable in formal citation, and on a 40-page PDF it attributes to 'Source 3' with a vague highlight - i.e. citation granularity is the actual complaint, not citation presence. Sharing: Pro has 'Chat-Only' share that exposes the assistant without exposing raw sources. Limits free 100 notebooks/50 sources per notebook/50 chats a day; Pro 300 sources per notebook, 500 notebooks. Collaborators do not consume host limits.
